description: Analysis artifact, not a seed source. Cross-references Princeton WordNet 3.1's punctuation/punctuation_mark synset (06854415-n) against the WordSeeder's hand-curated closed-class PUNCTUATION cache (punctuation.json) and, for hyponyms punctuation.json doesn't cover, the closed-class SYMBOL cache (symbols.json) -- several WordNet 'punctuation' hyponyms (ampersand, hyphen/dash, solidus/slash) are actually seeded under part_of_speech SYMBOL rather than PUNCTUATION. NOT listed in WordSeeder.MANDATORY_FILES / SUPPLEMENTARY_FILES and therefore never loaded or seeded.

source_synset.gloss: the marks used to clarify meaning by indicating separation of words into sentences and clauses and phrases

holonym.note: 06854415-n has exactly one holonym pointer (#p, Part Holonym) -- 'punctuation' is treated as part of 'orthography/writing_system'. Neither lemma of that holonym synset appears anywhere in punctuation.json (which lists individual mark symbols, not this kind of abstract whole), so the holonym itself yields no overlap with the punctuation seeder.
holonym.gloss: a method of representing the sounds of a language by written or printed symbols

hyponyms.gloss: a punctuation mark (&) used to represent conjunction (and)

matched_symbols_json_entries.definition: An Ampersand is an Other Punctuation.

hyponyms.note: Seeded under part_of_speech SYMBOL, not PUNCTUATION.

matched_punctuation_json_entries.definition: An Apostrophe is an Other Punctuation.

A Left Single Quote is an Initial Quote Punctuation.
A Right Single Quote is a Final Quote Punctuation.

A Right Double Quote is a Final Quote Punctuation.

hyponyms.note: WordNet models 'quotation mark' as one generic sense; punctuation.json seeds every individual quote-glyph variant, so this one hyponym matches nine separate entries.

hyponyms.note: Seeded under part_of_speech SYMBOL, not PUNCTUATION. The Reverse Solidus (\) and Fraction Slash (⁄) are related glyphs, not literal WordNet lemmas of this synset, but share its 'separator mark' sense.

hyponyms.gloss: a punctuation mark used in text to indicate the omission of a word
hyponyms.note: No swung-dash glyph (⁓) is seeded in either punctuation.json or symbols.json -- genuinely unmatched.

punctuation_json_entries_with_no_wordnet.definition: An Interrobang is an Other Punctuation.

punctuation_json_entries_with_no_wordnet.note: None of the four punctuation.json entries above have a symbols.json counterpart either -- interrobang, ellipsis, and the inverted Spanish marks are absent from both closed-class caches.
